opti.brief: Welcome under the sea, crew. We film Scene 22, What Washed In. Show me how trash harms a reef, then take the shot.
opti.studio: No headset today? Come to the studio. Clean the creek, but leave what lives there. Then tell me what you think.

steps.title: Know your models
steps.html:
Type each gray word in the Filter models box.

@MODELS@

This list is also on the Canvas tab in VR.

steps.title: Go on location
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Ocean in Filter environments. Click Under The Ocean, then Begin Solo.

steps.title: Build the scene
steps.html:
Press the top button on your right controller, then click Models. Set the Red Coral down, with the Reef Fish and Green Sea Turtle near it. Then add the trash: the Fishing Net and the Water Bottle.

✋ Grab a model with the palm trigger. Use both palm triggers to make it bigger or smaller.
🗣 Say it out loud: “The ___ harms the ___ because ___. People can help by ___.”

steps.title: Take the shot and send it
steps.html:
Stand back so the whole scene fits. Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Click Take photo.

Click the Canvas tab and pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 Want to fix it? Move the models, take a new photo and send it again.

steps.title: Check and leave
steps.html: Press the Meta button, then click Quit. Check that your photo is in the Canvas assignment. Not there? Open Having trouble in VR?

studio.title: Clean the creek

labels.done: The creek is clean, and you know how to keep it that way. Nice work, crew!
labels.start: Tap one piece of litter, or drag it to the bin.
labels.cleared: All 4 pieces of litter are in the bin. The living things are still here.

studio.look: A creek is a small stream. Litter is trash left on the ground or in the water. Eight things are in this creek. Four live here. Four are litter.
studio.do: Tap each piece of litter, or drag it to the bin. Leave the living things where they are.

items.name: Green frog
items.msg: Leave the frog. It lives here and eats insects.

items.name: Plastic bottle
items.alt: Empty plastic water bottle left in a bush
items.msg: In the bin! A plastic bottle lasts for many years and breaks into tiny bits.
items.why: A plastic bottle lasts for many years and breaks into tiny bits.

items.name: Water lily
items.alt: White water lily flower floating among green lily pads
items.msg: Leave the water lily. It gives shade and shelter.

items.name: Plastic bag
items.alt: White plastic bag of trash caught in dry brush
items.msg: In the bin! An animal can swallow a plastic bag or get stuck in it.
items.why: An animal can swallow a plastic bag or get stuck in it.

items.name: Old can
items.alt: Rusty old drink can lying on sand
items.msg: In the bin! A can has sharp edges, and small animals can get stuck inside.
items.why: A can has sharp edges, and small animals can get stuck inside.

items.name: Sunfish
items.alt: Small sunfish swimming near rocks under water
items.msg: Leave the fish. This creek is its home.

items.name: Cup and straw
items.alt: Clear plastic cup with a straw lying on wet sand
items.msg: In the bin! Rain can carry a cup and straw down the creek, all the way to the sea.
items.why: Rain can carry a cup and straw down the creek, all the way to the sea.

items.name: Dragonfly
items.msg: Leave the dragonfly. It hunts insects over the water.

action.name: One way to help
action.alt: Black litter bin with a covered top beside a path
action.q: Which action keeps litter out of the creek?

options.lid: 🚮 Put trash in a bin with a lid
options.rain: 🌧️ Leave it for the rain to wash away

action.miss: Try again. Rain can still carry that litter to the creek.

frames.lead: 1. How does litter harm a creek?
frames.starter: I think litter harms the creek because ___.

frames.lead: 2. What is one way people can help?
frames.starter: I saw that ___, so people can help by ___.

studio.full: You put all 4 pieces of litter in the bin and picked the action that helps. Your 2 sentences have at least 20 words.

voice.brief: Welcome under the sea, crew. We film Scene 22, What Washed In. Show me how trash harms a reef, then take the shot.
voice.step1: Before your headset goes on, meet your five models. Learn each gray search word. You will type it in VR.
voice.step2: Put on your headset. Click Explore, type Ocean, and pick Under The Ocean. Then click Begin Solo.
voice.step3: Build the reef home first: coral, fish and turtle. Then add the net and the bottle. Tell me what the trash harms.
voice.extra: Got time? Make the reef busier with two more animals. That shot is just for VR crews.
voice.step4: Step back so the whole scene fits. Click Library, then Camera, and take the shot. Then send it to Canvas.
voice.step5: Press the Meta button and click Quit. Then open Canvas. Your photo should be waiting there.
voice.studio: No headset today? Come to the studio. Clean the creek, but leave what lives there. Then tell me what you think.
